variants.description: Five de novo missense variants (individual notations not given in abstract)
phenotypes: hypogonadotropic hypogonadism features (primary amenorrhea, micropenis, cryptorchidism, decreased testicular size)

variants.description: One de novo nonsense variant (notation not given in abstract)
phenotypes: variable features of the SOX11 syndrome (hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, microcephaly, short stature, hypotonia, autism/ADHD)

variants.description: One de novo whole-gene deletion of SOX11
phenotypes: variable features of the SOX11 syndrome

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo variants in SOX11 with consistent phenotype; mostly novel variants

clinical.citation: First observation of secondary childhood glaucoma in Coffin-Siris syndrome: a case report and literature review (PMID: 33430815)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: Novel de novo heterozygous variant found by whole exome sequencing, classified as likely pathogenic; 18-gene congenital glaucoma panel was normal

clinical.citation: Deletion 2p25.2: a cryptic chromosome abnormality in a patient with autism and mental retardation detected using aCGH (PMID: 18992374)

variants.description: de novo cryptic 2p25.2 deletion encompassing SOX11 (detected by aCGH)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo pure 2p25.2 deletion removing SOX11, with a severe phenotype consistent with a role for SOX11 haploinsufficiency

clinical.citation: Impaired communication ability in SOX11 syndrome (PMID: 37916390)

variants.description: Not specified (individuals with a diagnosis of SOX11 syndrome)
phenotypes: impaired language structure (speech, syntax, semantics, coherence)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Diagnosed SOX11 syndrome; specific variants not given in abstract

model_organism.citation: Epithelial SOX11 regulates eyelid closure during embryonic eye development (PMID: 33662665)
phenotypes: Epithelial SOX11 deficiency causes failure of embryonic eyelid closure (eyelids open at birth)
Defective extension of the leading edge of the eyelid
Decreased c-Jun level in the eyelid of epithelial SOX11-deficient embryos
Systemic SOX11-deficient mice are born with unclosed eyelids (cited background)

model_organism.citation: Sox11 is an Activity-Regulated Gene with Dentate-Gyrus-Specific Expression Upon General Neural Activation (PMID: 32080705)
phenotypes: Conditional Sox11/Sox4 knockout in the dentate gyrus produced reduced excitability of DG granule cells, the opposite of the SOX11 overexpression/enrichment phenotype
Upregulated expression of potassium channel subunits, opposite to the overexpression effect

model_organism.citation: Sox11 genes affect neuronal differentiation in the developing zebrafish enteric nervous system (PMID: 40789027)
phenotypes: CRISPR-Cas9 depletion of sox11a and sox11b reduced the number of enteric neurons expressing the inhibitory motor neuron marker adcyap1b
No effect on cell proliferation or cell death
Sox11 binding sites required for adcyap1b enhancer-driven reporter expression

model_organism.citation: ASHG 2014 - De novo SOX11 mutations cause Coffin-Siris syndrome
Cochlear nerve deficiency in SOX11-related Coffin-Siris syndrome (PMID: 35642566)
phenotypes: Homozygous Sox11 ablation: reduced sensory neuron survival and decreased axonal growth (cited from prior literature)
Heterozygous knockout mice: hearing impairment with grossly normal inner ear structures

model_organism.citation: Androgens Drive SOX9 Upregulation in Injured Proximal Tubular Cells (PMID: 41279940)
phenotypes: Tubule-specific Sox11 deletion worsened kidney injury (AKI) in both sexes, indicating a protective role
Sox4 and Sox11 equally upregulated and protective in males and females

model_organism.citation: scRNA sequencing uncovers a TCF4-dependent transcription factor network regulating commissure development in mouse (PMID: 34184026)
phenotypes: TCF4 and SOX11 cooperatively control commissure formation in vivo (combined Tcf4/Sox11 genetic manipulation)
Regulate transcription of genes implicated in commissure formation

biological.citation: Zhang et al. 2022 - SOX11-dependent CATSPER1 expression controls colon cancer cell growth through regulation the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway (PMID: 35305240)
biological.summary: SOX11 acts as a transcription factor that activates CATSPER1 transcription in colorectal cancer cells (luciferase reporter, qPCR, western blot). CATSPER1 promotes CRC proliferation in vitro and in xenografts, partly through PI3K/AKT activation, placing SOX11 upstream of a SOX11-CATSPER1-PI3K/AKT axis.

biological.citation: Expression and Clinicopathological Significance of SOX11 in Small-Cell Lung Cancer (PMID: 35402616)
biological.summary: By immunohistochemistry, nuclear SOX11 is highly expressed in SCLC (63.33% positive) but low or absent in carcinoid/neuroendocrine tumors (12.5%), lung adenocarcinoma (0%) and squamous cell carcinoma (0%). SOX11 showed sensitivity 0.633 and specificity 0.875 as an SCLC diagnostic marker.
biological.significance: Significantly higher in SCLC than other types (p<0.05)

biological.citation: Regulation of SOX11 expression through CCND1 and STAT3 in mantle cell lymphoma (PMID: 30530749)
biological.summary: CCND1 interacts with and sequesters HDAC1/2 from the SOX11 locus, increasing H3K9/14 acetylation and SOX11 transcription. Phospho-Y705 STAT3 is inversely related to SOX11: JAK/STAT3 inhibition raises SOX11, while IL-21-induced or constitutively active STAT3 lowers it. SOX11 knockdown is toxic to SOX11+ MCL cells.

biological.citation: SOX11 regulates apoptosis and cell cycle in hepatocellular carcinoma via Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway (PMID: 30517979)
biological.summary: SOX11 is decreased in HCC tumors versus matched normal tissue. Overexpression in HuH-7 cells inhibits growth and induces apoptosis. It increases nemo-like kinase expression and TCF4 phosphorylation, which suppresses Wnt/β-catenin signaling, and it sensitizes cells to cisplatin and 5-FU, suggesting a tumor suppressor role.

biological.citation: SOX11 as a potential prognostic biomarker in hepatocellular carcinoma linked to immune infiltration and ferroptosis (PMID: 39246708)
biological.summary: In contrast to the earlier HCC report, SOX11 was elevated in HCC (TCGA/GEO, validated by IHC) and predicted survival. It correlated with immune infiltration, immune checkpoint genes and ferroptosis genes. SOX11 knockdown in HepG2 and HuH7 cells reduced proliferation and migration.

biological.citation: SOX11 promotes epithelial/mesenchymal hybrid state and alters tropism of invasive breast cancer cells (PMID: 32909943)
biological.summary: SOX11 is an embryonic mammary epithelial marker normally silenced before birth. In ER-negative DCIS.com cells, SOX11 drives hybrid epithelial/mesenchymal, invasive populations. In xenografts, SOX11-high cells metastasize more to brain and bone and less to lung.

biological.citation: Human fetal cerebellar cell atlas informs medulloblastoma origin and oncogenesis (PMID: 36450980)
biological.summary: SOX11 was identified, together with HNRNPH1, as a transcriptional determinant in transitional cerebellar progenitors enriched in group 3 medulloblastoma, and it correlates with prognosis. SOX11-targeted super-enhancers form long-range chromatin loops to MYC cis-regulatory elements. Targeting these regulators inhibited MYC expression and group 3 MB growth.

biological.citation: SOX11 regulates PAX5 expression and blocks terminal B-cell differentiation in aggressive mantle cell lymphoma (PMID: 23321250)
biological.summary: SOX11 promotes tumor growth in an MCL xenograft model. ChIP-on-chip with expression profiling after knockdown identified PAX5 as a major direct target. SOX11 silencing downregulates PAX5, induces BLIMP1 and shifts cells toward plasmacytic differentiation, so SOX11 blocks terminal B-cell differentiation.

biological.citation: Sox11 is an Activity-Regulated Gene with Dentate-Gyrus-Specific Expression Upon General Neural Activation (PMID: 32080705)
biological.summary: In adult mice, SOX11 is induced within 6 h by electroconvulsive stimulation or novel environment exploration, restricted to dentate gyrus granule neurons; ~75% of SOX11+ DG neurons are c-FOS+. SOX11 overexpression enhanced granule cell excitability and downregulated potassium channel subunits, whereas conditional Sox11/4 knockout showed the opposite phenotype.

biological.citation: Lineage specific transcription factor waves reprogram neuroblastoma from self-renewal to differentiation (PMID: 38653778)
biological.summary: The SOX11 super-enhancer and SOX11 expression decrease with ATRA-induced neuroblastoma differentiation. CRISPR-Cas9 and siRNA show neuroblastoma cells depend on SOX11 in vitro and in vivo. dCAS9-KRAB silencing of the SOX11 SE reduces SOX11 mRNA and inhibits growth.

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - SOX11 is necessary for development of the bony labyrinth (Sperry et al.)
biological.summary: Sox11-/- mice show lateral semicircular canal fusion plate failure and canal dysplasia, and Sox11+/- mice show canal abnormalities and mild high-frequency hearing loss. Bmp4, Otx1 and Shh are misregulated. Sox11 expression depends on CHD7 in a dosage-dependent manner (reduced in Chd7 Gt/+, absent in Gt/Gt ears), linking SOX11 to Coffin-Siris and CHARGE pathogenesis.
biological.sample_size: Sox11+/- n=26 ears (10 abnormal); Sox11-/- n=12 ears
